question.text: For a listed NPO on SSE, the Annual Impact Report (AIR) has a DUAL role per Chapter 7.3.2. Identify the correct pair.

answer.text: Trend analysis and providing a baseline/midline for successive years

explanation.text: The Logic: Chapter 7.3.2 states: 'The Annual Impact reports typically perform a dual role, viz. (i) prepare a trend analysis of the NPO/FPEs performance and (ii) provide a baseline and midline for successive years.' The Trap: Options B, C, D are tax/corporate-governance functions, not AIR functions.
